title.zh: 生成即补充：体现的关系项的生起本身需要补充，在耗散之下没有有限部分独自承担它
title.en: Generation is replenishment: the arising of an embodied relatum itself needs replenishment, and under dissipation no finite part bears it alone

claim.zh: 以一类关系项读依存网与流。在平衡的流中，一个体现的关系项至少被给予它生起时的水平：生起前它不活跃，所以水平为零；生起后它活跃，所以水平为正。于是它的生起补充每个包含它的家族；一个家族的体现成员在任意晚的步生起时，家族的补充在任意晚的步出现，不论取用什么。生成在这里本身承担要求，不经由它带来的取用。在耗散之下，给予一个被耗散家族的形成从家族取用，所以在一个跨某步封闭的不重复家族中，体现成员的生起降低家族的存量。体现成员在任意晚的步生起的不重复有限家族，从任何一步起都不封闭：在任意晚的步有参与的形成与其外交换。有限个关系项就是全部时，体现的关系项不在任意晚的步生起。于是 dissipation_ceases 的前提（一个量从不上升，每次生起都使它下降），对封闭家族中体现成员的生起，由平衡、耗散与体现推出。每个前提都必要：两方来回传递一份水平，在两个关系项的封闭世界中体现地、不息地生成，而不耗散（Handing）；持有者每步另燃一份新的燃料时，传递在耗散之下继续，包含一方的每个不重复有限家族在任意晚的步都不封闭（Kindling）；一个活动不是其水平的关系项，在一个关系项的耗散世界中不息地生起（Flicker）；只给予不取用的世代不耗散（Brood.not_dissipative）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Read webs and flows with one kind of relatum. In a balanced flow an embodied relatum is given at least the standing it arises with: before it arises it is not active, so its level is zero, and after it is active, so its level is positive. Its arising therefore replenishes every family containing it, and where embodied members of a family arise at arbitrarily late steps, the family's replenishment recurs at arbitrarily late steps, whatever is taken. Here generation carries the requirement itself, not through the uptake it brings. Under dissipation a formation giving to a family dissipated on takes from it, so in a family without repetition closed across a step the arising of an embodied member lowers the family's stock. A finite family without repetition in which embodied members arise at arbitrarily late steps is not closed from any step on: at arbitrarily late steps some formation taking part exchanges with a relatum outside it. If finitely many relata are all there is, embodied relata do not arise at arbitrarily late steps. The premise of dissipation_ceases (a quantity that never rises and is lowered by every arising) thus follows, for the arisings of embodied members of a closed family, from balance, dissipation and embodiment. Each premise is needed: two sides handing one standing back and forth generate, embodied and without end, in a closed world of two relata that is not dissipative (Handing); when the holder also burns a fresh fuel at every step, the handing goes on under dissipation, and every finite family without repetition containing a side is open at arbitrarily late steps (Kindling); a relatum whose activity is not its standing arises without end in a dissipative world of one relatum (Flicker); generations giving without taking are not dissipative (Brood.not_dissipative). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 流平衡依存网；家族与每步参与的关系项都是有限列表；量是自然数，单位可公度。
hypotheses.en: The flow balances the web; families and the relata taking part at each step are finite lists; amounts are natural numbers with commensurable units.

hypotheses.zh: Embodied 是对生起的关系项的表示前提：它恰在活跃时以正的水平作为条件而在。遗骸与不活跃的条件不体现；哪些关系项体现是应用义务。不体现的生起不受这些结论约束（Flicker）。它在一类读法的同一对应下读：哪个条件就是哪个形成由共同的索引给出（relabel，见 life-as-condition-of-life）。
hypotheses.en: Embodied is a representational premise about the arising relata: each stands as a condition at a positive level exactly while it is active. Remains and inactive conditions are not embodied; which relata are embodied is an application duty. Arising that is not embodied is not constrained by these conclusions (Flicker). It is read under the one-kind identification: which condition is which formation is supplied by the shared index (relabel, see life-as-condition-of-life).

hypotheses.zh: 耗散（Dissipative，见 no-finite-part-bears-taking）是物理前提，只用于耗散之下的结论；它只约束有封闭有限家族的步（见 no-finite-part-bears-taking 的 Spray），本结果在耗散之下的结论都关于封闭的有限家族。
hypotheses.en: Dissipation (Dissipative, see no-finite-part-bears-taking) is a physical premise, used only for the conclusions under dissipation; it constrains only steps at which some finite family is closed (see Spray in no-finite-part-bears-taking), and this result's conclusions under dissipation all concern closed finite families.

correspondence.zh: 第五次独立审查（I3）指出，在流的形式中生起只经由它带来的取用起作用，并在其 §4 列出：一个耗散的流的定理会让生成本身而不是取用承担要求。no-finite-part-bears-taking 的界限写明结论不约束不取用的生起；life-as-condition-of-life 写明 Brood 不耗散、耗散之下的一类读法未陈述。本结果在一类关系项的读法中回答这三处。Ren 的原话是“生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向”。作者把结果读作原话中“生”与“整体”之间关系的一种形式内容：若生起的生命自身就是其他生命的条件，每次生起都是一次补充；在耗散之下，不息的生起不能由任何有限的部分独自承担（作者的诠释，AI 论证）；它不替代 Ren 的原话，也不推出它是好的。实际的生命是否体现、实际的量是否耗散，是对应与经验问题。
correspondence.en: The fifth independent review (I3) found that in the flow form arising contributes only the uptake it brings, and listed in its §4 that a dissipative flow theorem would make generation itself, rather than uptake, carry the requirement. The boundary of no-finite-part-bears-taking says its conclusion does not constrain arising without taking; life-as-condition-of-life says Brood is not dissipative and the one-kind reading under dissipation is not stated. This result answers all three in the one-kind reading. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). The author reads the result as one formal content of the relation between 生 and the whole in those words: where an arising life is itself a condition of other lives, every arising is a replenishment, and under dissipation unceasing arising cannot be borne by any finite part alone (the author's interpretation, an AI argument); it does not replace Ren's words and does not show that it is good. Whether actual lives are embodied, and whether actual quantities dissipate, are questions of correspondence and evidence.

detail.zh: 复用一类关系项的读法、Embodied、SelfBearing 与 Brood；把体现的关系项经由给予而生起推进为“生成即补充”。
detail.en: Reuses the one-kind reading, Embodied, SelfBearing and Brood; carries embodied arising through giving on to generation as replenishment.

output.zh: 体现的关系项只经由给予而生起。
output.en: An embodied relatum arises only as it is given to.

input.zh: 体现的生起补充家族，在耗散之下降低封闭家族的存量。
input.en: An embodied arising replenishes the family and, under dissipation, lowers a closed family's stock.

detail.zh: 复用 ClosedAt、DissipatesOn、Dissipative、runs_down 与 Frontier 的燃料；新增 DissipatesOn.takes_of_gives；把该记录关于取用的结论推到体现的生起。
detail.en: Reuses ClosedAt, DissipatesOn, Dissipative, runs_down and Frontier's fuels; adds DissipatesOn.takes_of_gives; carries that record's conclusion about taking on to embodied arising.

output.zh: 被耗散的家族至少下降其取用者的数目。
output.en: A family dissipated on falls by at least its number of takers.

input.zh: 体现成员的生起使封闭家族下降。
input.en: An embodied member's arising makes a closed family fall.

detail.zh: 复用流、平衡、取用、给予、补充、Acting 与有限和的引理。
detail.en: Reuses flows, balance, taking, giving, replenishment, Acting and the lemmas on finite totals.

output.zh: 平衡：水平的变化恰是给予与取用之差。
output.en: Balance: a change of level is exactly what is given less what is taken.

input.zh: 生起时的水平全由给予承担。
input.en: The standing an embodied relatum arises with is all given.

output.zh: 从不上升的量只下降有限次。
output.en: A quantity that never rises falls only finitely often.

input.zh: 封闭家族的存量从不上升，每次体现的生起都使它下降。
input.en: A closed family's stock never rises and every embodied arising in it lowers it.

detail.zh: 回答第五次审查 I3：该记录的流形式中生起只经由取用起作用；这里体现的生起本身承担要求。该记录的 dissipation_ceases 所设的物理前提，对封闭家族中体现成员的生起被推出。
detail.en: Answers I3 of the fifth review: in that record's flow form arising works only through uptake, while here embodied arising carries the requirement itself. The physical premise supplied to that record's dissipation_ceases is derived for the arisings of embodied members of a closed family.

detail.zh: 整体与部分：在耗散之下，体现的生成不由任何有限的关系项家族独自承担。整体的演绎仍开放。
detail.en: Whole and parts: under dissipation embodied generation is not borne by any finite family of relata alone. The whole deduction remains open.

detail.zh: 没有耗散，体现的生成可以在封闭的有限世界中不息（Handing.handing）：持有者归还它所取，两方轮流生起。
detail.en: Without dissipation, embodied generation can be unceasing in a closed finite world (Handing.handing): the holder gives back what it takes and the two sides arise in turn.

detail.zh: 不体现的生起不需要补充：Flicker 在一个关系项的耗散世界中不息地生起（Flicker.flicker）；两类读法中没有形成体现（roles_not_embodied）。
detail.en: Arising that is not embodied needs no replenishment: Flicker arises without end in a dissipative world of one relatum (Flicker.flicker); in the two-kind reading no formation is embodied (roles_not_embodied).

detail.zh: 前提相容并且结论可达：Kindling 平衡、耗散，两方体现并承担自身，各自在任意晚的步生起；包含一方的每个有限家族在任意晚的步打开（Kindling.frontier）。Brood 不耗散（Brood.not_dissipative）。
detail.en: The premises are consistent and the conclusion attained: Kindling balances and is dissipative, both sides are embodied and bear on themselves, and each arises at arbitrarily late steps; every finite family containing a side opens at arbitrarily late steps (Kindling.frontier). Brood is not dissipative (Brood.not_dissipative).

limitations.zh: 不含伦理谓词；只约束体现的关系项的生起，不体现的生起不受约束；Embodied 是表示前提，遗骸、种子库与不活跃的条件不体现；耗散是物理前提，单位可公度；generation_opens 只约束在一个有限家族中复现的生成，不断生起新的关系项（如 Brood）不在任何有限家族中复现；“有限”指有限的关系项家族；见证都是最小见证，Handing 中持有者取用自身的水平，不读作汲取；新名称最终由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: Contains no ethical predicate; constrains only the arising of embodied relata, and arising that is not embodied is unconstrained; Embodied is a representational premise, and remains, seed banks and inactive conditions are not embodied; dissipation is a physical premise with commensurable units; generation_opens constrains only generation recurring in one finite family, and arising of ever new relata (as in Brood) recurs in no finite family; “finite” means a finite family of relata; the witnesses are minimal, and in Handing the holder takes its own standing without that being read as drawing; the final choice of names is Ren's.

validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261009T071936.578078Z): the 28 theorems added to Becoming.Roles and the one added to Becoming.Dissipation all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 20 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 676 theorems/1115 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. The author's counterreview is in §20 of the integration note; no independent review yet. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 22 modules, every declaration in it has an empty axiom report, and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: 缓冲、储备、种子库与休眠之下的体现（活动与水平不同步）；生成在多大程度上必须读作体现（Ren）；有理数量的版本；体现的生成与“更多”在耗散之下的关系；实际生命中体现与耗散的经验对应。
next_delta.en: Embodiment under buffers, reserves, seed banks and dormancy (activity and standing out of step); how far generation must be read as embodied (Ren); a version with rational amounts; the relation of embodied generation to “more” under dissipation; the empirical correspondence of embodiment and dissipation in actual lives.
